name: hermes-mobile-app
description: A mobile app for Hermes, built around Bots! Similar to Grok Bot but completely Open Source and runs on your own computer, Hermes Mobile is a beautiful and first-of-its-kind cross-platform app (thanks to Tauri) featuring everything you need to control your Bots running on your computer from anywhere in the world. 🌎 Open-Source Grok Bot 🌍
